verification_scope: Provider wind direction convention for research adapter; not a check of live deployment version or NOAA raw forecast fields
method: Official Open-Meteo pinned source review: GFS regular latitude-longitude grid and 10m UGRD/VGRD mapping; DerivedMapping windDirection; MeteorologyTests cardinal FROM-direction examples. API units and ordered times are separately checked on each response.
review_findings: GfsDomain.gfs013 is a regular geographic latitude/longitude grid; gfs025 is also regular geographic.
GfsVariableDownloadable explicitly maps 10m U/V to UGRD/VGRD 10 m above ground.
DerivedMapping.windDirection uses Meteorology.windirectionFast and optionally corrects projected HRRR/NAM directions to true north.
Official cardinal examples: westward U=-4,V=0 gives90deg FROM east; eastward gives270deg; southward V=-4 gives360deg FROM north; northward gives180deg.
Reading these definitions supports use of the explicit GFS wind_direction_10m response as true-north clockwise FROM; this is a source-based inference.
limitations: The live API does not disclose its software revision or original forecast issuance cycle.
No live NOAA original U/V or GRIB rotation flags were compared in this fallback.
Public GFS spatial resolution cannot resolve local terrain/fire-induced winds; one point is treated as uniform over the scenario domain.
This evidence does not establish the wind axes of KMA KIML; KMA component direction remains unverified.
Non-commercial research use of the free API only. Data CC-BY-4.0; underlying NOAA GFS. No provider endorsement.
This convention check is not wildfire accuracy validation.
